system.description:
[Trigger: Action] You use this when you perform a [Special Attack] with "Target: Wide Area 1 (Select)/Range: Close" at the same time. This changes the [Special Attack] to "Target: Straight Line 4 (Select)". Once per scenario. A clockwork guitar characterized by a sharp silhouette and a rigid tone. When the strings are scraped, silver shooting stars fly around, and the number increases as the beat becomes more intense.

[Core Material](120G)+ (110G)+[ 8](70G)×4+Crafting Cost(220G)
